name: Antigravity Console
description: Multiple Google accounts with weighted session-sticky load balancing, smart auto-routing and fallback, quick quota popover, usage & per-session cost analytics, artifacts & subagent views, interactive question and task cards, and Orchestrator model choices for Paseo's built-in Antigravity provider.

zh-CN.name: Antigravity 控制台
zh-CN.description: 为 Paseo 内置的 Antigravity provider 提供多账号加权负载均衡与智能自动切换、侧边栏快捷额度浮层、用量与单对话账单、产物与子代理视图、交互式提问与任务卡片以及 Orchestrator 设置。
